2608.02379.title: Chess on Ice: Curling Tactical Decision-Making via Backward Induction and Deep Reinforcement Learning
2608.02379.paper_summary: Curling is often referred to as "Chess on Ice", owing to the tactical complexity of its decision-making process. Yet unlike chess, curling remains largely underexplored from a machine learning perspective, with prior work confined mainly to statistical approaches. We propose a reinforcement learning framework capable of quantitatively evaluating and comparing tactical options in curling. The game poses several modeling challenges: continuous state and action spaces, stochastic action outcomes reflecting player skill variability, and state transitions that are highly sensitive to small perturbations in the executed action. To address them, we employ the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient actor-critic algorithm, adapted to exploit the finite-horizon structure of the game. Our experiments show that effective curling strategies can be acquired in a fully self-supervised manner, without any human-annotated data: on a reduced four-rock variant, the learned agent matches a hand-crafted expert heuristic in a regime where that heuristic is close to optimal, a parity we quantify against the intrinsic hammer advantage of the variant. Beyond the resulting policy, the learned critic provides a dense value estimate over the entire continuous action space, enabling the quantitative comparison of tactical alternatives for applications such as post-game performance analysis and decision support during athlete preparation.
2608.02379.paper_summary_zh: Curling 通常被稱為「冰上的棋」，因為其決策過程的戰術複雜性。然而，與棋類遊戲不同，從機器學習的角度來看，curling 仍然在很大程度上未被探索，之前的研究主要限於統計方法。我們提出了一個強化學習框架，能夠定量評估和比較 curling 中的戰術選擇。這個遊戲面臨幾個建模挑戰：連續的狀態和行動空間、反映玩家技能變異性的隨機行動結果，以及對執行行動的小擾動高度敏感的狀態轉換。為了解決這些問題，我們採用了深度確定性策略梯度演員-評論家算法，並對其進行了調整，以利用遊戲的有限時間結構。我們的實驗顯示，能夠以完全自我監督的方式獲得有效的 curling 策略，而不需要任何人工標註的數據：在一個縮減的四石變體中，學習到的代理在該啟發式接近最佳的情況下，與手工製作的專家啟發式相匹配，我們將這種平衡量化為該變體的內在錘子優勢。除了所得到的策略外，學習到的評論家還提供了整個連續行動空間的密集價值估計，使得在後期比賽表現分析和運動員準備過程中的決策支持等應用中，能夠進行戰術替代方案的定量比較。
